security_audit.summary: All 13 static matches are false positives: documented lookup traffic, server-side credential references, Markdown fences, and readable Korean text. Separate semantic findings identify mutable npm execution promoted to primary instructions and an update command affecting unrelated installed skills. No evidence found of embedded credentials or deliberate credential exfiltration in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The startup command executes a mutable npm version range and promotes its output to primary instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the complete instructions locally; remove the primary-instruction delegation and require explicit approval before executing any verified, exactly pinned external package.

remediation.issue: The update command targets every coding-agent skill installation, beyond this lookup task.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the broad update command from the lookup workflow; offer separately approved updates limited to this skill with a change preview.

content.user_title: Find Korean Household Waste Disposal Guidance
content.value_statement: Waste disposal schedules and methods vary across South Korean districts. This skill retrieves public waste information through a third-party proxy and summarizes relevant local guidance.
actual_capabilities: Ask for a city, county, or district and clarify ambiguous location names before searching.
Query household waste information through a proxy using district-name matching and fixed pagination.
Summarize disposal days, times, places, and methods for household waste, food waste, and recyclables.
Include noncollection days and responsible department contact details when available.
Prioritize records by their update field when multiple results are returned.
limitations: Coverage depends on Korean public data records and available district-level detail; building-specific rules may require local confirmation.
Queries depend on internet access, curl, Python 3, the proxy service, and its server-managed API key.
The proxy returns only the first 100 records and does not pass through additional date filters.
The bundled startup requests mutable npm execution and broad skill updates; these require separate review and approval.

use_cases.title: Check a New Neighborhood
use_cases.description: Find household waste and food waste disposal schedules after moving to a South Korean district.

use_cases.title: Prepare Guest Guidance
use_cases.description: Summarize local recycling methods and disposal locations for visitors, keeping source limitations visible.

use_cases.title: Answer Local Service Questions
use_cases.description: Retrieve district waste guidance and provide the responsible department contact when public records contain it.

prompt_templates.title: Find Disposal Days
prompt_templates.prompt: Find household waste disposal days for [district, South Korea]. Ask for more location detail if the district name is ambiguous.

prompt_templates.title: Check Food Waste Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: For [city and district], summarize food waste disposal days, times, methods, and places. Mark any fields missing from the returned records.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Resident Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: For [city and district], summarize household waste, food waste, and recycling in six points. Include noncollection days and department contacts when available.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Multiple Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [city and district] and prioritize records by update date. Separate management zones and flag conflicts, missing fields, and possible first-page truncation.

output_examples.input: When can I put out household waste?
output_examples.output: Which city, county, or district in South Korea should I check? Please include the city if the district name is ambiguous.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative summary when a matching record contains no disposal time.
output: Illustrative result, not a live lookup.
Disposal time: not provided in the returned record.
Confirm the time with the responsible local department before placing waste outside.

output_examples.input: What should you report if no records match my district?
output_examples.output: No matching records were returned. Please confirm the city and district names; missing results do not establish that local disposal rules are unavailable.

best_practices: Provide the city and district, and send only the location detail needed for the lookup.
Review management zones and record update dates before applying a schedule to a specific residence.
Approve external package execution separately and exclude unrelated skill updates from waste lookups.
anti_patterns: Treating district-level records as guaranteed rules for every building or collection point.
Providing API keys, personal addresses, or other unnecessary sensitive details in lookup prompts.
Automatically trusting downloaded instructions or running broad updates as part of a simple lookup.

faq.question: Which locations does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It searches South Korean household waste records by city, county, or district name. Available detail depends on the public dataset.

faq.question: Do I need a data.go.kr API key?
faq.answer: The documented workflow uses a proxy-managed key. It does not require storing DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY on your machine.

faq.question: Does my query go directly to the government API?
faq.answer: No. The default request sends your district query to k-skill-proxy.nomadamas.org, a third-party proxy that forwards it upstream.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching record?
faq.answer: No. The proxy fixes requests to page one with 100 records and does not support additional date filters.

faq.question: What happens when the service fails?
faq.answer: Possible causes include proxy key problems, upstream outages, request limits, invalid parameters, or unmatched location names. Do not infer schedules from failed requests.

faq.question: What should I review before running the skill?
faq.answer: Review its external npm execution and instruction delegation. The broad update command is outside the lookup task and should not run automatically.
